# With -exec the sources reach the compiling host as a tar archive on the
# prefix's standard input, not through a shared filesystem. The fake
# compiling host keeps its files under $WORK/vm, and its nvcc fails when
# handed any path outside it: it cannot see the sources in $WORK/src.
[!exec:sh] skip
[!exec:tar] skip
chmod 0755 vm.sh nvcc
mkdir vm

exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/vm.sh -remote-tmp $WORK/vm -launchers -I inc -nvcc $WORK/nvcc src/k.cu
stdout '_Z5spillPfPKf'

# The source, the header it includes by a relative quoted name, the one it
# includes by an angled name from -I, and the wrapper arrived. A toolkit
# header found in neither place stays on the compiling host.
exec cat files
stdout '^\./cudacompilecheck-[0-9-]+/src/.*/src/k\.cu$'
stdout '^\./cudacompilecheck-[0-9-]+/src/.*/src/common/k\.cuh$'
stdout '^\./cudacompilecheck-[0-9-]+/src/.*/inc/k_inc\.cuh$'
stdout '^\./cudacompilecheck-[0-9-]+/src/.*/0/wrap\.cu$'
! stdout cuda_runtime
exec cat wrapinc
stdout 'ok'

# Everything is removed afterwards.
exec find vm -mindepth 1
! stdout .

# Paths in the compiler's output name the local files.
! exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/vm.sh -remote-tmp $WORK/vm -D FAIL -nvcc $WORK/nvcc src/k.cu
stderr '^\S*/src/k.cu\(1\): error: boom$'
! stderr '/vm/'

# -shared-fs hands the compiling host the local paths, which this one
# cannot see.
! exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/vm.sh -remote-tmp $WORK/vm -shared-fs -nvcc $WORK/nvcc src/k.cu
stderr 'host path .*/src/k.cu'

-- vm.sh --
#!/bin/sh
# A stand-in for limactl shell on a host that shares no files with this
# one: drop flock(1) and timeout(1), and run the command here.
[ "$1" = flock ] && shift 6
[ "$1" = timeout ] && shift 4
exec "$@"
-- nvcc --
#!/bin/sh
# Every path argument must be on the compiling host, and an include
# directory absolute.
for a in "$@"; do
	p=${a#-I}
	case $p in
	$WORK/vm/*) ;;
	$WORK/*) echo "host path $p" >&2; exit 1;;
	esac
	case $a in -I/*) ;; -I*) echo "relative include directory $a" >&2; exit 1;; esac
done
out=
prev=
for a in "$@"; do
	[ "$prev" = -o ] && out=$a
	case $a in -DFAIL) last=; fail=1;; esac
	prev=$a
	last=$a
done
if [ -n "$fail" ]; then
	echo "$last(1): error: boom" >&2
	exit 1
fi
(cd $WORK/vm && find . -type f | sort) > $WORK/files
# The wrapper includes the copy of the source.
inc=$(sed -n 's/^#include "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' "$last")
case $inc in $WORK/vm/*) [ -f "$inc" ] && echo ok > $WORK/wrapinc;; esac
: > "$out"
cat $WORK/ptxas.txt >&2
-- src/k.cu --
#include "common/k.cuh"
#include <k_inc.cuh>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
template <int N> __global__ void scale(float* y) {}
inline void launch_scale(float* y) { scale<128><<<1, 128>>>(y); }
-- src/common/k.cuh --
#pragma once
-- inc/k_inc.cuh --
#pragma once
-- ptxas.txt --
ptxas info    : 0 bytes gmem
ptxas info    : Compiling entry function '_Z5spillPfPKf' for 'sm_90a'
ptxas info    : Function properties for _Z5spillPfPKf
    992 bytes stack frame, 2232 bytes spill stores, 2660 bytes spill loads
ptxas info    : Used 32 registers, used 0 barriers, 992 bytes cumulative stack size
